_comment: Directory sync service client used by the backend scheduled job (admin REST user-storage/{id}/sync). Merge into the realm export (clients[] + roles + users[] + scopeMappings); secret comes from env KC_DIRECTORY_SYNC_SECRET, never committed.

realm.name: continuum-directory-sync
realm.description: Trigger user-federation sync (POST user-storage/{id}/sync) and resolve the LDAP component by name. Composite of manage-users (required by the sync endpoint) + view-realm (required to list components by name) only; no manage-realm, no clients access.
